bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd "$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
root="$(pwd -P)"
wt="$root/.worktrees/notice-live-20261127"
repo=seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot
target=aa942c607efb90a6f05012e7a224ccc7d5260364
stage="$root/deploy/state/reliability-pr81-e2368044/userbot-merged"
service=gace-userbot-verify.service
test "$(gh api repos/$repo/pulls/81 --jq '.head.sha')" = "$target"
for run in 46059161595 46059161614 46059161633 46059161656; do
 test "$(gh run view "$run" -R "$repo" --json headSha,status,conclusion --jq '.headSha+" "+.status+" "+.conclusion')" = "$target completed success"
done
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:reliability-e2368044)"
test "$(systemctl --user show -p WorkingDirectory --value "$service")" = "$root"
systemctl --user is-active --quiet "$service"
systemctl --user is-enabled --quiet "$service"
python3 -B scripts/userbot_test_client.py health
test "$(git hash-object scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py)" = d1e04d169d47d4f746f922b5bfe0c1439c847a44
test "$(git hash-object scripts/userbot_test_client.py)" = 347742ef01c34ecd6328c5d510100a1382bf56f8
test ! -e "$stage"
mkdir -m 700 "$stage"
mkdir -m 700 "$stage/reference"
git -C "$wt" fetch origin refs/heads/fix/notice-live-adopted-20261127
test "$(git -C "$wt" rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$target"
for f in userbot_help_burst_merge.py userbot_resident_ipc.py userbot_test_client.py; do
 git -C "$wt" show "$target:scripts/$f" > "$stage/reference/$f"
done
test "$(git hash-object "$stage/reference/userbot_help_burst_merge.py")" = 28315c78f53c00009bc0fa5a561b5955d12f3a83
test "$(git hash-object "$stage/reference/userbot_resident_ipc.py")" = 364f9f33eb76e9e86ebf2bab988d005f96e47446
test "$(git hash-object "$stage/reference/userbot_test_client.py")" = 12b091eb061e8d674e1ed74e7af947c5768564d2
python3 -B "$stage/reference/userbot_help_burst_merge.py" --current "$root/scripts" --reference "$stage/reference" --output "$stage/merged"
for f in userbot_resident_ipc.py userbot_test_client.py; do
 python3 -B - "$stage/merged/$f" <<'PY'
import pathlib,sys
p=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]);compile(p.read_bytes(),str(p),'exec')
PY
 cp -p "scripts/$f" "$stage/$f.old"
done
test "$(git hash-object scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py)" = d1e04d169d47d4f746f922b5bfe0c1439c847a44
test "$(git hash-object scripts/userbot_test_client.py)" = 347742ef01c34ecd6328c5d510100a1382bf56f8
changed=0
activated=0
restore(){
 rc=$?
 trap - EXIT
 if test "$changed" = 1 && test "$activated" != 1; then
  for f in userbot_resident_ipc.py userbot_test_client.py; do
   cp -p "$stage/$f.old" "scripts/$f"
  done
  systemctl --user restart "$service"
  echo USERBOT_CODE_ROLLBACK
 fi
 exit "$rc"
}
trap restore EXIT
changed=1
for f in userbot_resident_ipc.py userbot_test_client.py; do
 install -m "$(stat -c '%a' "scripts/$f")" "$stage/merged/$f" "scripts/$f"
 cmp -s "$stage/merged/$f" "scripts/$f"
done
systemctl --user restart "$service"
ready=0
for i in $(seq 1 20); do
 if systemctl --user is-active --quiet "$service" && python3 -B scripts/userbot_test_client.py health; then ready=1; break; fi
 sleep 2
done
test "$ready" = 1
systemctl --user is-enabled --quiet "$service"
activated=1
echo USERBOT_CODE_ACTIVATION=PASS
python3 -B scripts/userbot_test_client.py help_button_burst_smoke
python3 -B scripts/userbot_test_client.py bot_start_menu
systemctl --user is-active --quiet "$service"
python3 -B scripts/userbot_test_client.py health
echo GAYBBS_LIVE_BUTTON_BURST=PASS
